speaker: Doctor

text: No, I haven't traveled anywhere recently, and no one around me has been sick. I just thought my cough was due to a lingering cold from a few weeks ago. speaker: Doctor
text:
I must clarify that an "unstable angina" diagnosis is inconsistent with your chest X-ray showing right lower lobe consolidation and the absence of elevated white blood cells, which are classic signs of pneumonia. Given this discrepancy, please confirm if you have experienced any chest pain, shortness of breath during exertion, or jaw/arm discomfort to rule out cardiac involvement definitively.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pneumonia (Right Lower Lobe)
